reviews_5s:
Well madeDo the job !
The with tend to tint easily tho... after a month of use you can see the carot leaving a tint on it.Rubber bottom keeps this heater from slipping, which makes it easy to use. This product for grating fresh turmeric, ginger & garlic for my bone broth! Makes shredding cheese bricks a breeze, too. The size & shape make it simple to keep in any drawer, not so bulky as a conventional grater - great if you live in a small place!Nice little cheese grater for the price. Sturdy plastic with a rubber heel and a good size opening for your hand. Cleans easily and easy to use, just need cheese.Nice little grater. Small enough to slide in tight places for easy stowing. Study enough to leaning into some carrots or potatoes when grating.Worked great to shred zucchini for my zucchini bread recipe. Awesome price, sturdy & nice quality, and super easy to clean. Definitely would buy again.I had another flat grater for 22 years and it broke. I bought this one and I love it! Comfortable and easy to use. Cleans easily too.We purchased this to replace a white plastic bordered grater that broke and it more than fulfilled its job. We use it to grate cheese (Cracker Barrel Sharp Cheddar). Since they are making the graters of much flimsier metal, we don't recommend using it for lettuce, but for the softer cheeses, it's fine. Not sure how it would do with Parmesan. That might be too hard.We mostly use it for cheese to use in cooking or toppings. But occasionally use it for fruit zest. The non skid bottom is very handy. Keeps everything on the cutting board or counter.excellent product! I recommend it!
reviews_1s: This was to replacement for our 12 year old grater that was solid, functional for everything needing to be grated . This is thing is no replacement. 1. Flimsy, bends and twists with every move. 2. You have to use caution with every swipe, where the old model you really didn’t even think about it. 3 weeks after receiving this garbage, we were prepping out taco night. Grating the cheese, the flimsy plastic frame cracked top left and bottom right corners using light pressure.I should have read the reviews. The slicer part is so dull it cuts NOTHING! I had one just like it and broke but it was sharp. The reviews stated this part is a problem. Please correct this or it’s another item in the dump!Cheap quality of materials used. Flexes while grating and cracked in no time.Thre blade is weak and flimsy! Does not work at all well as a grater. Tempe to return it!!! ABSolute OF MONEY!!!!!!!! DULL AND WEAK!!!!!Slicer not well designed. Was practically impossible to slice cucumber rounds. Used a knife instead. Not worth the price.The slicer only works well using the same side as the grater. That makes it difficult to slice since the vegetables cross the grater also. I have a similar product that slices from the other side so vegetables don’t hit the grater.Terrible product. Maybe OK for grating but I bought it for slicing. Trying to slice potatoes is a waste of time. Bought a different brand which works much better.I should have spent a few more dollars on a better grater. The metal is too thin and flexes when you push against it leading to inconsistencies. The one I owned before this lasted decades and worked well. I suspect this one will end up in the trash after a few more uses.It's very flimsy and cheaply made. The grater part of it flexes and I don't expect it to hold up but I'll use it til it completely fails.Look... this is not a complex device ...either it is sharp and shreds potatoes and carrots or it does not. This device is not sharp enough ... thus does a poor job of a simple task. Not much else to say. Avoid.
